assessments.name: Reflective Journal
assessments.description: A reflective journal outlining student learning processes and achievements
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 09 Jun 2026 at 23:59

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task
assessments.description: Students use week 1-3 experience to select one object on the weeks 5-12 lists and select and justify it for presentation. Rubric on Canvas.

assessments.name: Q&A following object analysis presentation
assessments.description: A question and answer session involving questions from tutors and staff posed immediately after the student presentation on individual objects. The Q and A will elicit and test follow up, depth of research and ability to spontaneously answer queries.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Group presentation Week 13
assessments.description: An Oral presentation presented live, in a group, marked as a group  and assessed live (2500-word equiv. total)

assessments.name: Object Analysis (Individual Oral presentation)
assessments.description: Students individually present one object chosen from the objects in the OBL classes (Weeks 5-12) and present with cue cards only (no computers, no powerpoint) in front of or with the object. Research (cue cards) to be submitted to Canvas.
